  • Method Details

    • findByAccountIdAndClientReference

      Optional<Order> findByAccountIdAndClientReference(Integer accountId, UUID clientReference)
      Finds a prior order by its idempotency key. Checked before creating a new order so a retried submission returns the original outcome instead of being validated and possibly executed a second time.
